macro_trends.name: Sustainable Living
macro_trends.description: The trend toward more ecologically responsible consumerism, focusing on sustainable sourcing and eco-friendly production.
drivers: Growing consumer awareness of environmental issues
Increasing demand for ethically sourced materials
design_implications: Highlight sustainability credentials prominently in marketing

macro_trends.name: Personalization
macro_trends.description: Consumers increasingly seek personalized products tailored to their individual preferences.
design_implications: Offer options for monograms or custom colors/patterns
Utilize customer input for product development

micro_trends.name: Vintage Aesthetic
micro_trends.recommended_use: Use vintage-inspired designs and patterns in marketing and product offerings to appeal to nostalgic sentiments.
design_notes: Utilize retro color palettes and patterns

micro_trends.name: Wellness Focus
micro_trends.recommended_use: Emphasize how quality bedding contributes to health and wellness in campaigns and product descriptions.
design_notes: Integrate calming imagery and soothing language in promotional content
Highlight benefits related to sleep hygiene

category_cliches_to_avoid: Claims of 'best ever' or 'luxury' without substantiation
deliberate_break_points: Highlight authentic Egyptian cotton sourcing and certifications clearly to differentiate from competitors
Focus on direct-from-factory pricing to emphasize value without sacrificing quality
